content: No authoritative source found describing AddressBook.sqlitedb (ZABCDRECORD etc.) schema deltas release-to-release; only that it's the on-disk Contacts store and its schema has drifted historically the way Photos.sqlite and chat.db have. Treat as an unverified risk requiring direct on-device schema probing before shipping a sqlite-backed contacts read plane, same as #70's Envelope Index fingerprinting pattern.
